description: This PHP class 'Keys' manages OAuth2 key generation and retrieval, including generating RSA keys and reading public/private key files.

classes.name: Keys
classes.description: A class for managing OAuth2 RSA key pair generation and access.

methods.name: getPublicKey
methods.description: Returns the public key content, generating keys if not present.

methods.name: getPrivateKey
methods.description: Returns the private key content, generating keys if not present.

methods.name: setUpKeys
methods.description: Generates a new RSA key pair and saves them to files.
